name: chase clients for missing tax documents with AI

parameters.content:
## chase clients for missing tax documents with AI

### How it works

This workflow automates tax document chasing and intake for an accounting firm. On a daily schedule, it reads the client checklist, assesses whether each client needs a reminder, escalation, or all-clear notice, then sends AI-drafted reminder emails and logs updates in Airtable. A separate webhook receives incoming document notifications, validates the intake data, records matched documents, and alerts the firm when data is missing or a client cannot be matched.

### Setup steps

- Configure Airtable credentials and set the base/table mappings for the client checklist, document status updates, and activity logs.
- Configure Gmail credentials for sending client reminders and owner/error notification emails.
- Configure Telegram bot credentials and chat IDs for owner alerts, all-clear posts, confirmations, and intake error notices.
- Configure the OpenAI chat model credentials used by the AI reminder drafting agent.
- Set the firm settings nodes with the correct firm name, owner email, firm email, and any other sender/contact details.
- Set the daily schedule trigger timing and expose/configure the document-received webhook URL for the document intake source.

### Customization

Adjust the assessment logic for reminder and escalation timing, the AI reminder prompt and fallback email text, the Airtable field names, and the Telegram/Gmail notification wording to match the firm’s process.

## Load chase checklist

Starts the daily chase run, applies firm-level settings, and reads the client checklist from Airtable.

## Assess chase routing

Evaluates each client row and routes the client to the correct chase action: reminder, escalation, or all-clear.

## Draft reminder email

Uses an AI agent and chat model to draft a client reminder, then parses the AI response with a deterministic fallback.

## Send reminder record

Emails the reminder to the client, stamps the reminder date in Airtable, and logs the reminder activity.

## Notify owner escalation

Alerts the owner on Telegram and sends an escalation email when a client requires attention.

## Log escalation status

Updates the client record with the escalation date and logs the escalation in Airtable.

## Post all clear

Posts an all-clear message to Telegram and records that no chase action was needed.

## Receive document intake

Receives document submissions through a webhook, normalizes the payload, adds intake firm settings, and validates required fields.

## Validate known client

Looks up the submitted client in Airtable, verifies the client match, and prepares the receipt path for known clients.

## Record received document

Records the received document in Airtable, logs the receipt, and confirms the successful match on Telegram.

## Handle missing fields

Builds an invalid-intake notice when required fields are missing, then alerts Telegram and sends an email notice.

## Handle match failure

Alerts the firm when an intake submission has valid fields but cannot be matched to a known client, then emails a failure notice.

options.systemMessage: You are the client care assistant at a bookkeeping and tax firm. Write a short, warm reminder email to a client who still has not sent the documents listed below so their tax return can be finished. List the missing documents clearly, keep it under 140 words, friendly and specific, no guilt-tripping, no corporate filler, no em dashes. End with a simple ask to reply with the documents. Return ONLY valid JSON with two keys: subject and body. No markdown, no code fences.
